Frequently asked questions
How does the 7-day trial work?
Choose a plan and add your card to start a 7-day free trial. Your card is not charged until the trial ends, and we’ll email you before your plan starts billing. Your subscription then renews automatically unless you cancel in your account settings. You can run Fathom alongside your existing analytics while you try it.
Standard or Business?
Standard has every analytics feature and works for most sites. Business is for teams, and for companies that build on their analytics. It adds 10 team seats plus you, admin, editor and viewer roles, control over which sites each person sees, a team audit log, higher API limits and priority support. On both plans, anyone can view a shared dashboard or receive an email report, and they never take a seat.
How do team seats work?
Each person you invite takes one seat, and you never take one yourself. A pending invitation takes a seat until it’s accepted or revoked. Need more than the 10 included seats? Add them from your billing settings at $10/month or $100/year each, up to 50 seats. The people you invite don’t need a plan of their own. See our
teams guide
for roles and site access.
Do I need Business when my traffic grows?
Nope. Standard and Business both cover 100,000 to 25 million pageviews a month, so traffic never forces a plan change. Choose Business when other people need their own login. Over 25 million?
Talk to us
about a custom plan.
Can I explore Fathom before signing up?
We don’t do sales calls or live demos, but our software is ridiculously easy to use. You can watch our
10-minute walkthrough
, click around the
live dashboard
or give Fathom a 7-day free trial alongside your existing analytics. Every feature is
documented
, and if you have specific questions, we’re here by
email
.
Do you offer a free plan?
Nope, and here’s why: we’ve invested heavily in fast, reliable infrastructure (we don’t host Fathom on cheap servers that go offline). Our business model is selling software, not your data, so we’ve priced Fathom to be sustainable for a very long time.
What happens if I hit my pageview limit?
We’ll never turn your analytics off for occasional traffic spikes. If you stay well over your limit, we’ll email you about a larger plan, and you decide whether to upgrade or cancel (no hard feelings either way). We send a few friendly reminders and extra time before we pause dashboard and API access, and we keep collecting your data throughout. See our
plan-limits guide
for the details.
Can I change my pageview limit?
Of course! If you exceed your limit for two months in a row, we’ll get in touch about a larger plan. Or, if you’re under your current tier for two months in a row (and it’s not our lowest tier already), you can move to a smaller plan from your billing settings.
How many sites does my plan include?
Every plan includes at least 50 sites, and bigger plans include more. Move the slider above to see exactly how many. If you need more, you can add packs of 50 extra sites yourself from your billing settings, at $10/month or $100/year per pack, on Standard or Business.
We run a product that creates a site for every customer.
Lovely!
Get in touch
. We have plans built for platforms with thousands of sites, and we’ll set one up with you.
Can I pay by invoice?
Standard and Business are paid by card, monthly or yearly. Yearly invoicing and purchase orders are part of our custom plans, so
reach out
and we’ll help.
How do I cancel my account or trial?
We’re not interested in having someone’s money if they aren’t happy. You can cancel anytime, right from your account settings. You don’t have to call or email us (unless you have a question). There are no contracts, and you can export your data before cancelling.
Do custom events count towards my pageview limit?
Yes. If you use custom events on your website or send them through our API, each one counts towards your monthly pageview allowance.
Have another question?
Reach out
! We’re happy to help with any pre-sales questions.
